items.exampleEn: My only desire is a quiet life.
items.exampleZh: 我唯一的渴望就是過安靜的生活。

items.exampleEn: The film is about a man's mental problems.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影講的是一個男人的心理問題。

items.exampleEn: This old song touches my soul.
items.exampleZh: 這首老歌觸動了我的心靈。

items.exampleEn: Teenagers often go through emotional changes.
items.exampleZh: 青少年常會經歷情緒上的變化。

items.exampleEn: She answered every question with confidence.
items.exampleZh: 她充滿自信地回答每一個問題。

items.exampleEn: He is proud of his small garden.
items.exampleZh: 他對自己的小花園很自豪。

items.exampleEn: My cousin is gay, and his family fully supports him.
items.exampleZh: 我表哥是同志，他的家人完全支持他。

items.exampleEn: I feel guilty about forgetting her birthday.
items.exampleZh: 我忘了她的生日，覺得很內疚。

items.sentenceEn: Speaking in front of many people takes a lot of confidence.
items.sentenceZh: 在很多人面前說話需要很大的自信。

items.audioEn: He felt guilty because he broke his brother's toy.
items.audioZh: 他弄壞了弟弟的玩具，覺得很內疚。

items.sentenceEn: The film tells the story of a gay couple and their family.
items.sentenceZh: 這部電影講述一對同志伴侶和他們家人的故事。

items.sentenceEn: He became emotional when he saw his old friend again.
items.sentenceZh: 他再見到老朋友時，情緒很激動。

items.stemEn: She was ____ of her son when he won the prize.
items.stemZh: 兒子得獎時，她以他為榮。

items.stemEn: After her first speech, her ____ grew, and the second one was easier.
items.stemZh: 第一次演講後她的自信增加了，第二次就比較容易。

items.passageEn: Owen was always shy. He had a strong desire to sing on stage, but he had no confidence, so he kept this dream from his parents. His friend Leo told him, "Just be yourself." So Owen practiced constantly, and singing became good mental exercise for him. At the school concert, he sang with all his heart and soul. It was an emotional night. His parents felt very proud, and Owen no longer felt guilty about hiding his dream from them.
items.passageZh: Owen 一直很害羞。他非常渴望站上舞台唱歌，但他沒有自信，所以一直沒讓父母知道這個夢想。他的朋友 Leo 對他說：「做你自己就好。」於是 Owen 不斷地練習，唱歌也成了他很好的心理鍛鍊。在學校音樂會上，他全心全意地唱。那是一個令人感動的夜晚。他的父母非常驕傲，Owen 也不再因為對他們隱瞞夢想而感到內疚。

questions.questionZh: Owen 一開始為什麼不敢上台唱歌？
音樂會那天晚上，Owen 的父母覺得怎樣？

items.promptZh: 我為我的團隊感到驕傲。
referenceEn: I am proud of my team.
I feel very proud of my team.
rubricZh: be proud of＋人、事物等，of 不可少
也可寫，例如 feel proud of 等

items.instructionZh: 用 confidence 造一個句子，說說什麼事讓你更有自信。
referenceEn: Learning English gives me more confidence at work.
My confidence grew after I gave my first speech.
rubricZh: confidence 是不可數名詞「自信」
可用 give someone confidence、my confidence grew 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 me、my）
